versions.changelog: v1.0.0: first stable. In-page floating 🔔 picker (no DevTools needed); 11 sound presets grouped into Basic / Animal Crossing / Super Mario / Retro; per-row Preview; cache-busts every detected OpenClaw install; auto-skips when upstream completion-sound lands.
v0.3.3: docs — render screenshot inline on ClawHub by switching to markdown image syntax + GitHub raw absolute URLs (ClawHub strips raw HTML tags).
v0.3.2: docs — remove GIF reference from SKILL.md (ClawHub doesn't render it); keep static screenshot.
v0.3.1: docs — add animated widget demo GIF in README/SKILL.md alongside the static screenshot.

v0.3.0: floating bell picker widget (no DevTools needed); 11 presets grouped into Basic / Animal Crossing / Super Mario / Retro; per-row Preview button; SKILL renamed to 'echo' (package slug stays echo-cue).
Default behavior change: ring in foreground tabs too (set milly.completionCue.onlyHidden=on to restrict to hidden tabs only).
Align SKILL name field with published slug (echo-cue).
Initial release: two-tone Web Audio chime when an assistant reply finishes streaming. Stop-gap for openclaw/openclaw#69186 / PR #73894.
